newsitem.title: USA: Encore Wire stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Encore Wire stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Fidelity Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said it cut its stake in Encore Wire Corp to 529,300 common shares or 7.4 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the sale of 87,200 common shares between June 5 and June 27 at prices ranging from $26.5253 to $30.0728 per share.
The company, based in McKinney, Texas, manufactures copper electrical wire for commercial, industrial and residential use.
